title: ALMA Observations of HCN and HCO<SUP>+</SUP> Outflows in the Merging Galaxy NGC 3256
question: Is dense gas (HCN, HCO+) present in the molecular outflows of the merging galaxy NGC 3256, and how do outflow line ratios and physical conditions differ from the nuclei and between the AGN-hosting southern and starburst northern outflows?

data.bands: Band 3 for HCN/HCO+ (1–0); CO(2–1) Cycle 3 archival; CO(1–0) and CO(3–2) Cycle 0 archival

what.value: Radio peaks used to define North- and South-Nucleus positions

evidence.quote: We define North-Nucleus and South-Nucleus (stars in Figures) as the peaks of the radio emission (cite: Neff+03).

what.value: 54%/46% split of red-shifted CO between southern and northern outflow

evidence.quote: we assume 54$\%$ and 46$\%$ of the red-shifted components arise from the southern and northern nucleus, respectively (cite: Sakamoto+14)

what.value: SFR ~6 Msun/yr within ~3" of the southern nucleus from IR SED fitting

evidence.quote: We adopt SFR of $\sim6$ M$_{\odot}$ yr$^{-1}$ [^4] for the $\sim3.0\ensuremath{''}$ region around the southern nucleus, which is derived from infrared SED fitting (cite: Lira+08).

what.value: Inclination of 80 deg for de-projecting outflow velocity

recipe.method: Continuum subtraction and tclean with automasking; beam-matched, uv-clipped (>18 kλ) cubes for all CO and dense gas lines

recipe.goal: Identify outflow components and measure fluxes
recipe.method: Moment 0 maps over extreme velocity ranges; integrate nuclei over channels with S/N>3; 3 sigma upper limits for non-detections
assumptions: Southern share of CO(1-0) at OF-Red set by blue flux ratio, giving ~5 Jy km/s

recipe.goal: Derive outflow masses, rates and power
recipe.method: Mass = alpha x luminosity; age = l/V; Mdot = M/age; kinetic power; compare with supernova power 7e41 x SFR
Ratios in brightness temperature of CO 2-1/1-0, 3-2/1-0, HCN/CO, HCO+/CO, HCN/HCO+ in each region and velocity channel

recipe.goal: Non-LTE RADEX modelling with Bayesian likelihood
recipe.method: Single-phase RADEX grid fit to five line fluxes for North-Nucleus, South-Nucleus, South-OF-Blue
key_parameters: Tkin 5–6300 K, nH2 1e1–1e7 cm-3, NCO 1e12–1e22 cm-2, FF 1e-5–1, abundance ratios 1e-7–1e-3

evidence.quote: larger in the southern outflow (0.20$\pm$0.04 and 1.3$\pm$0.2, respectively)
than in the southern nucleus (0.08$\pm$0.01, 0.7$\pm$0.1, respectively)

answer_key.quantity: SFR from dense gas in outflow

evidence.quote: we estimate $SFR$ = 0.003-0.14 \[M$_\odot$ yr$^{-1}$\] from dense gas mass associated with outflow

not_stated_but_needed: Exact line-free channels used for uvcontsub
Details of CO(2-1) channel width and uv-clip for CO data
Priors and grid sampling for the Bayesian RADEX analysis
How beam-matching and region apertures were applied for flux measurement
Source of the SFR-dense gas mass relation used
missing_for_reproduction: Line-free channels and image grid parameters
score_reason: Public data and many parameters stated, but line-free channels, imaging grids and Bayesian details missing.
rediscovery_reason: Public ALMA data, imaging recipe mostly given, and results are numeric line ratios and fluxes.
